responsibility: Implements the legacy Rust symbol mangling algorithm used by the GCC Rust backend. It encodes canonical path segments into the old _ZN...E namespace form, performs the legacy substitutions for qualified paths, generics, references, pointers, punctuation, and non-ASCII Unicode codepoints, computes the trailing type-based hash from TyTy::BaseType::mangle_string using an FNV128 helper, and combines those pieces into the final assembler symbol for a resolved item path.
